reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin-development runtime that hosts third-party guest plugins in fresh Linux Bubblewrap processes and exposes their tools and prompt sections with narrowly scoped read-only workspace-file access.

summaries.zh: 在 Linux Bubblewrap 隔离进程中运行第三方 DeepSeek Harness 插件，并注册其工具和静态系统提示片段。
summaries.en: Runs third-party DeepSeek Harness guests in fresh Linux Bubblewrap processes and registers their tools and static system-prompt sections.

capabilities: Executes integrity-pinned third-party JavaScript guests in isolated Linux Bubblewrap subprocesses
Registers guest-provided tools and static system-prompt sections with DeepSeek Harness
Provides explicitly granted read-only access to individual workspace files
